---
title: Bulk Add Members
description: >-
  Learn how to import multiple customers at once by uploading a CSV file and
  matching profile images, choose a delivery method, and bulk enroll them into
  your loyalty program.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1375" height="759" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Dashboard, view pass details.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="499" height="271" />

2. Click add members button.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="384" height="284" />

3. Upload CSV & profile image file or use manual entry.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="438" height="283" />

4. (For Upload CSV file method) CSV image file name **MUST** match with profile image file name.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="499" height="236" />

5. Select delivery method.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="439" height="300" />

6. Preview uploaded member data & add members.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="395" height="300" />
